_note: Tier 2 merges for delegate designation and institution, decided one cluster at a time by the conference owner on 2026-09-04. Every line here is a human call, NOT a similarity score -- the script that applies it does no matching of its own. That separation exists because 'Kasturba Nursing College, Sevagram' (47 delegates) and 'Kasturba Nursing School, Sevagram' (8) are different institutions one word apart, and any rule loose enough to catch the MGIMS spellings also merges those two.
_format: canonical value -> the exact stored spellings that should become it. Matching is exact after the mechanical tidy in homogenise-free-text.js; nothing is guessed.

_rejected.Government Medical College (all cities): NOT merged. Clustering swept Akola, Nagpur, Jangaon, Singrauli, Siddipet, Jalna, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Gondia and Jalgaon into one group -- nine different colleges. Only the two acronym pairs below are real.
_rejected.District Hospital: NOT merged. Katni (MP), Kabirdham (Chhattisgarh) and Kovilpatti (Tamil Nadu) are different hospitals sharing a generic name.
_rejected.Mahatma Gandhi Medical College / MGM, In: NOT merged. MGM Indore is Mahatma Gandhi MEMORIAL Medical College, a different institution again from MGIMS Sevagram.
_rejected.Datta Meghe / JNMC: NOT merged into one. JNMC is a constituent college OF Datta Meghe Institute, so its own spellings are unified but the parent university stays separate.
_rejected.Clinical Instructor / PG, Clinical Instr: NOT merged. The five who wrote 'PG, Clinical Instructor' are also postgraduate students; merging drops that.
_rejected.Professor & HOD / Professor & HOD, Vice: NOT merged. Vice Dean is a further office.
_rejected.BSC Nursing student: NOT merged into MSc Nursing Student. BSc is undergraduate; MSc and PG Nursing Student are postgraduate.
